answer_1.quote: Recent studies in Natural Language Inference (NLI) have developed models to leverage natural language explanations as a mechanism for reasoning in support of a hypothesis.

answer_2.quote: We adopt a range of automatic metrics to measure the quality of explanations and autoformalisation, showing that the proposed framework significantly improve the faithfulness of the autoformalisation process.

answer_4.quote: We also perform a manual evaluation to assess the perceived quality of the formalised logical forms and conduct an extensive ablation study, elucidating the role of each proposed component and identifying key factors influencing automated theorem proving for NLI.
answer_4.guideline: We conducted a human evaluation on three types of errors: variable errors (identifiable by the theorem prover), implication errors, and quantifier errors
